value.produces: host-native MAME aa310 binary + verified A310/RISC OS 3.11 romset + golden savestate (Apps Filer window open on the Desktop)

labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE (de-bridged from day one): MAME 0.289's aa310 (Acorn Archimedes 310) runs on the host — no QEMU/QMP, no guest OS to shell into, no exec channel. Frames drawshm->shm, keys and the pointer over ctlsock. RISC OS 3.11 is entirely ROM-resident (bios=311); there is no disk image. Launcher stations/mame-native/x11-runtime.sh; reset relaunches and restores sta/aa310/golden.sta. The pointer is a CLOSED LOOP on the VIDC's own hardware-cursor registers (m_crtc_regs[6]/[14]) — three buttons: Select/Menu/Adjust.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# riscos3 (VMID 213) — RISC OS 3.11 on an Acorn Archimedes 310, host-native
# MAME aa310: ROM-resident OS (bios=311), drawshm frames, ctlsock keys and a
# closed-loop absolute pointer read from the VIDC's own cursor registers.

museum.periodBrowser: none — no networking on this exhibit in the first wave
museum.blurb: Acorn's native ARM desktop — the icon bar, the Filer and the windowed applications that turned the ARM chip from an in-house processor experiment into a personal computer platform, five years before ARM licensed its first outside core.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's aa310 (Acorn Archimedes 310) runs on the host — drawshm frames, ctlsock keys and pointer, no audio in the first wave. RISC OS 3.11 is ROM-resident (bios=311 on the A310 romset); nothing is installed and there is no disk image. MEASURED 2026-09-20 on the pinned 0.289 binary: cold power-on reaches the RISC OS 3.11 Desktop in 21 s, and the golden savestate restores the Apps Filer window scene to a BYTE-IDENTICAL framebuffer. The pointer is 1:1 ABSOLUTE: the VIDC1a's own hardware-cursor registers are the sensor for the ctlsock closed loop, and ten spread targets over two laps landed within 3 px X / 2 px Y with no give-ups. All three Archimedes buttons work — Menu (middle) drops the Pinboard menu, Select (left) on the icon bar's Apps icon opens the Resources:$.Apps Filer window. See docs/lab/RISCOS3-WAVE.md.

reset.mouse: 1:1 ABSOLUTE, closed loop, MEASURED 2026-09-20. The Archimedes mouse is the keyboard device's own QUADRATURE pair (:keyboard:MOUSE.0 = X, :keyboard:MOUSE.1 = Y, both 16-bit analog; :keyboard:MOUSE.2 = three IP_ACTIVE_LOW buttons named Mouse Left / Mouse Center / Mouse Right). Two things had to be true before it moved at all. (a) UPSTREAM DISCARDED THE MAGNITUDE: archimedes_keyb.cpp's 4 kHz update_mouse emitted ONE quadrature step per non-zero delta and then assigned m_mouse_x = x, so a 600-count move moved the guest pointer ZERO pixels — mame-archimedes-kbd-mouse-carry.patch advances the recorded position by one unit per tick and keeps the remainder. (b) THE SENSOR IS THE VIDC: acorn_vidc.cpp draws the sprite at m_crtc_regs[CRTC_HCSR]/[CRTC_VCSR], elements 6 and 14 of a save_pointer'd u32[16], so the closed loop reads byte offsets 24 and 56 of that item — which needed mame-ctlsock-item-window-sized.patch, because the ram-cursor window only accepted byte arrays. Calibration, fitted over 8 points with a max residual under 0.6 px: published = -177 + reg*1.23127 (X), -58 + reg*2.65502 (Y). The 640x256 raster is LETTERBOXED inside the 1024x768 surface — reachable published pixels are roughly x 118..905, y 43..722, so the fleet's usual corner targets are outside the guest raster.
reset.keyboard: MEASURED 2026-09-20. The aa310 keyboard is a CPU-scanned matrix on :keyboard:ROW.0..ROW.15 behind the Archimedes keyboard MCU (acorn_0280,022-01_philips_8051ah-2.bin, an 8051 running its own ROM). riscos3.keymap is generated from the live ctlsock KEYDUMP (96 of 139 fields mapped; the rest are IPT_OTHER keyboard-ID bits, IPT_UNUSED, and the UK-layout '#' and '£' keys with no XT scancode). F12 opens the RISC OS command line on the framebuffer — the keyboard proof. Pacing is the scanned-matrix floor, 80/80 ms with MAME_CTL_KEY_EXCL on :keyboard:ROW; a press and its release must not arrive in the same window or the module coalesces them and the guest sees nothing.
reset.fixture: RISC OS 3.11 Desktop with the Resources:$.Apps Filer window open in the top left — !Alarm, !Calc, !Chars, !Configure, !Draw, !Edit, !Help and !Paint one Select-click away — over the mid-grey Pinboard backdrop, with the icon bar along the bottom (floppy :0, Apps, the palette and the Acorn task-manager icon) and the pointer parked on open backdrop. Drawn on the published 1024x768 surface by MAME 0.289's aa310 running HOST-NATIVE (drawshm). MEASURED 2026-09-20: cold power-on reaches the bare Desktop in 21 s; the golden savestate (137197 B, saved in 1.0 s) restores this scene to a BYTE-IDENTICAL framebuffer and the guest is still live afterwards (a Menu click still drops the Pinboard menu). aa310 is listed savestate="unsupported" in -listxml, so the restore is PROVEN rather than assumed. No disk is attached — RISC OS is entirely ROM-resident on this romset.

notes: scaffolded from apple2gs on 2026-09-20 (slot/udp/vmid 213); the sibling supplied only the registry row shape and the mame-native x11-runtime.sh launcher convention — driver, romset, pointer and keyboard are all aa310's own.

carries three patches authored here: mame-ctlsock-item-window-sized.patch (cursor window into a non-byte save item), mame-archimedes-kbd-mouse-carry.patch (the quadrature magnitude), and the ptr-tags/btn-active-low/ram-cursor trio the pointer binding needs. See docs/lab/RISCOS3-WAVE.md.
